models.name: TensorFold (TP=2)
models.stack: TensorFold Zig (MiaAI-Lab) · DSpark drafts · 2× DGX Spark

notes.model: Mia's Zig kit; weights EXL3 2.9 bpw EAQ with Engram's tables on local disk. No static KV pool: the engine reserves weights and pays KV as it fills (0.00 GiB per stream at the full window), so the 1,048,576-token window is proven for one long conversation.
notes.seats: ships with 4 seats; the c = 6–16 runs held 4 streams with the rest queued
